name: Cerise
source:
Popular member of the Writing Sect, close with Eve. She leads the Apologia Assembly punishing Maria's friend Jael.

She has a strong hatred of Magda. [spoiler]This has gone on since Magda was part of the Writing Sect, and Cerise led the Apologia Assembly that exiled Magda from that sect.[/spoiler]
